hooks.command: $j=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd()|ConvertFrom-Json;$fp=$j.tool_input.file_path;if($fp -and $fp -match 'networkpro' -and $fp -match '\.(ts|tsx)$' -and $fp -notmatch 'node_modules'){$n=(Get-Content $fp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Measure-Object -Line).Lines;if($n -gt 150){@{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PostToolUse';additionalContext="FILE TOO LONG: $fp has $n lines. Per CLAUDE.md, convert it into a directory (index.ts re-exports) and split."}}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress}}

# WHY: the project rule is a fresh branch off main for every change. Committing
# straight onto main has bitten this repo before (a late fix landed on an
# already-merging branch and was lost). Reads the hook payload from stdin and
# ignores anything that is not a commit.
# WORKTREE-AWARE: this hook always executes in the PRIMARY working directory, so
# a commit made inside a linked worktree -- how this repo isolates a change from
# a parallel session churning the shared tree -- was denied for the primary
# dir's branch instead of its own. Honour an explicit `git -C <dir>` target when
# the command carries one; with no -C it behaves exactly as before.
$j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json
$c = $j.tool_input.command
if ($c -notlike '*git commit*') { exit 0 }
$d = if ($c -match 'git\s+-C\s+(\S+)\s+commit') { $Matches[1] } else { '.' }
$b = (git -C $d rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>$null)
if ($b -eq 'main' -or $b -eq 'master') {
  $NL = [char]10
  $msg = 'Refusing to commit directly on ' + $b + '.' + $NL +
         'Branch off fresh main for every change:' + $NL +
         '  git fetch origin main; git checkout -b <type>/<slug> origin/main'
  @{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PreToolUse';permissionDecision='deny';permissionDecisionReason=$msg}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
}

# WHY: public/llms.txt and llms-full.txt are GENERATED from content/**. They
# previously went stale within six days (15 blog guides and 15 user-guide pages
# missing). If content changed but the generated files did not, the commit is
# shipping a stale AI-discoverability surface.
# It used to require public/llms* to be STAGED whenever content/** was, which
# denied every commit touching a page the generator excludes (development/**,
# roadmap/**, the API dump): those can never produce a diff, so the check was
# unsatisfiable and the only way past it was to not update the doc. It now runs
# the generator and compares worktree against index -- clean means in sync
# whatever the reason, and genuine staleness still blocks. The generator reads
# the WORKING TREE, so a partial commit made while other content edits sit
# unstaged is judged against those too; that is the same assumption the old
# "a clean tree means you are in sync" advice made, and generating from the
# index would mean stashing inside a hook.
$j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($j.tool_input.command -notlike '*git commit*') { exit 0 }
$root = (git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null)
if (-not $root) { exit 0 }
$content = @(git -C $root diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRD | Where-Object { $_ -like 'apps/web/content/*' })
if ($content.Count -eq 0) { exit 0 }
$w = Join-Path $root 'apps/web'
$gen = Join-Path $w 'scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs'
if (-not (Test-Path $gen)) { exit 0 }
$NL = [char]10
Push-Location $w
$out = node $gen 2>&1 | Out-String
$code = $LASTEXITCODE
Pop-Location
if ($code -ne 0) {
  $msg = 'Could not check llms.txt freshness -- the generator failed:' + $NL + $NL + $out
  @{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PreToolUse';permissionDecision='deny';permissionDecisionReason=$msg}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
  exit 0
}
$stale = @(git -C $root diff --name-only -- apps/web/public/llms.txt apps/web/public/llms-full.txt)
if ($stale.Count -gt 0) {
  $msg = 'public/llms.txt + llms-full.txt were stale for this content change.' + $NL +
         'Changed: ' + (($content | Select-Object -First 6) -join ', ') + $NL + $NL +
         'They have just been regenerated for you -- stage them into this commit:' + $NL +
         '  git add ' + ($stale -join ' ')
  @{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PreToolUse';permissionDecision='deny';permissionDecisionReason=$msg}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
}

# WHY: Rule 13, docs track code. A merged change that leaves docs describing the
# old behaviour is incomplete. This ASKS rather than denies, because some commits
# are genuinely doc-neutral (pure refactor, test-only, formatting).
$j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($j.tool_input.command -notlike '*git commit*') { exit 0 }
$files = @(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRD)
$src = @($files | Where-Object { $_ -like 'apps/web/src/*' -or $_ -like 'packages/*' })
$docs = @($files | Where-Object { $_ -like 'docs/*' -or $_ -like 'apps/web/content/*' -or $_ -match '[.]mdx?$' })
if ($src.Count -gt 0 -and $docs.Count -eq 0) {
  $NL = [char]10
  $msg = 'Rule 13 (docs track code): ' + $src.Count + ' source file(s) staged, no doc change.' + $NL +
         'Stale docs are a bug. Update the affected doc in the SAME commit:' + $NL +
         '  docs/checklist.md, docs/TIMELINE.md, the BRD/architecture section,' + $NL +
         '  SELF_HOSTING.md, README, or a code comment.' + $NL + $NL +
         'Proceed only if this is genuinely doc-neutral.'
  @{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PreToolUse';permissionDecision='ask';permissionDecisionReason=$msg}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
}

# WHY: the full verification suite is ~11 minutes, too slow to run inside a hook
# without timing out. So this does not pretend to check for you -- it forces one
# conscious confirmation that each step actually ran on THIS branch.
# Rule 12: 'tests pass' is wrong if any were skipped.
$j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($j.tool_input.command -notlike '*gh pr create*') { exit 0 }
$NL = [char]10
$msg = 'Pre-PR checklist (not auto-run -- confirm each actually passed on THIS branch):' + $NL + $NL +
       '  1. npx tsc --noEmit      apps/web, plus packages/core + packages/ee if touched' + $NL +
       '  2. npm run lint          0 errors' + $NL +
       '  3. npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism   serial is the only trustworthy signal on Windows' + $NL +
       '  4. npm run build         catches route/metadata errors tsc cannot' + $NL +
       '  5. Docs updated (Rule 13); if content/** changed, llms.txt regenerated' + $NL +
       '  6. UI change? verified in BOTH light and dark, and at 375px' + $NL + $NL +
       'Answer no and go run them if unsure.'
@{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PreToolUse';permissionDecision='ask';permissionDecisionReason=$msg}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue';$b=(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>$null);if(-not $b -or $b -eq 'main' -or $b -eq 'master' -or $b -eq 'HEAD'){exit 0};$dirty=(git status --porcelain 2>$null);$ahead=(git rev-list --count '@{u}..HEAD' 2>$null);$up=$?;$parts=@();if($dirty){$parts+='uncommitted changes'};if($up){if([int]$ahead -gt 0){$parts+="$ahead unpushed commit(s)"}}else{$parts+='no upstream (never pushed)'};if($parts.Count -eq 0){exit 0};$msg="Branch '$b' has "+($parts -join ' + ')+". Before wrapping up: tsc + tests + lint (+ next build if UI/RSC changed), update docs, then commit -> push -> open/update the PR.";@{systemMessage=$msg}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
